home.problem.text: 💡Abahinzi b'u Rwanda akenshi bahabwa inama rusange zitandukanye n'igihingwa cyabo, icyiciro cyacyo cy'ubu, cyangwa ikirere cy'uyu munsi — kandi igihe icyo gutera cyangwa akaga k'imvura ari nyakuri, inama rusange ntizihagije.
home.features.heading: Ibyo Ihiga ikora
home.features.weather.title: Yita ku bihe n'ikirere
home.features.weather.description: Inama zishingiye ku kirere cy'aho uri mu gihe nyacyo no ku bihe nyabyo by'ubuhinzi mu Rwanda.
home.features.stage.title: Ikurikirana icyiciro cy'igihingwa cyawe
home.features.stage.description: Izi icyumweru uriho, kuva ku gutera kugeza ku gusarura.
home.features.language.title: Ivuga ururimi rwawe
home.features.talk.title: Vuga cyangwa wandike
home.features.talk.description: Ijwi rikoreshwa mu kubaza ibibazo uri mu murima udakoresheje intoki.
home.features.photo.title: Fata ifoto
home.features.photo.description: Inama ku byo urebye ku gihingwa cyawe.
home.features.alerts.title: Imenyesha ihuse
home.features.alerts.description: Ubutumwa bugufi (SMS) igihe igihingwa cyawe cyangwa ikirere bikeneye kwitabwaho.
home.howItWorks.heading: Uko bikora
home.howItWorks.step1: Bwira Ihiga igihingwa cyawe n'itariki wateye.
home.howItWorks.step2: Baza ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose — mu nyandiko, ijwi, cyangwa ifoto — mu rurimi ushaka.
home.howItWorks.step3: Bonera inama nyakuri kandi zizewe — Ihiga akubwira niba inama ari rusange cyangwa yemejwe muri aka karere, aho kuvuga ikintu atazi neza.
home.trust.text: Inama za Ihiga zishingiye ku makuru y'ubuhinzi n'ibihe byemejwe mu Rwanda, atari ibitekerezo rusange.
home.footer.languagesLine: Ihiga iganira mu Cyongereza, mu Kinyarwanda (RW), no mu Gifaransa (FR) — tangira wandike mu rurimi wifuza.
home.footer.builtWith: Yakozwe hakoreshejwe Next.js, NestJS, na Groq.
